Community Leadership, Governance & EDI

STATSTRO Workshop ↗

Much of my academic service focuses on building cross-disciplinary bridges between astronomy, statistics, and data science, including serving as President of the SSC Data Science & Analytics Section (2025–2026), Interim Director of the U of T MScAC Data Science Concentration (2026–2027), Chair and committee member of the Astronomy & Astrophysics SURP, and co-organizing the annual STATSTRO Workshop.
